title: Recover the exact GCR-0003 R01 adverse-review projection

bootstrapUnit.exceptionReason: The independently reviewed GCR-0003 R01 adverse result cannot be represented by its packet-frozen runtime-v3 schema, and its exact normal projection topology cannot include the required controller/schema repair.

No representation of the bridge as the original direct-child R01 projection, no skipped/adverse review erasure, no finding closure, and no weakening of exact history validation outside the singular approved bridge.

acceptanceCriteria: The GCR-0004 packet, request/runtime/transaction schemas, authority manifest, proposal, and review page are Draft 2020-12 valid where applicable, path-safe, internally hash-bound, exact-commit reviewable, and inert.

Every GCR-0003 packet/review/approval/candidate/evidence/state/ledger, active-hold, backlog, W1, T03, W1.A04, G1, Git ancestry, and witness identity reproduces the exact frozen boundary and immutable bytes.
The failed review command is reproducible and byte-stable: it authenticates the exact ledger, fails only at the adverse-status runtime-v3 mismatch, and leaves state and ledger hashes unchanged.
GCR-0004 approval can be introduced only after an independent APPROVED packet review at the exact packet commit; its clean codex-branch introduction commit is the sole B00 implementation base.

B00 implementation changes only authorized controller/test/evidence/state paths, cannot edit runtime-v3 or the adverse ledger, keeps revision 9, and cannot apply the bridge before independent B00 approval.

The successor reader accepts only the exact independently approved GCR-0004 bridge, preserves reviewedStateCommit 702ffbc587cca2ec05567d86dc9fd0fa0a25b4a5, and rejects missing, stale, forked, adverse, substituted, dirty, or internally inconsistent authority byte-stably.
Application derives the exact GCR-0003 R01 attempt and CHANGES_REQUESTED state from the unchanged ledger, records explicit GCR-0004 recovery authority, and closes no finding.
Application and repeated recovery can yield only the exact frozen predecessor or exact ledger-derived successor, including abrupt child-process termination at every durable boundary.
The finalization commit is the direct child of application evidence and changes exactly the R01 ledger and GCR-0003 state; revision 9 and every ordinary execution gate remain closed.
Criterion-linked evidence, adversarial real-Git coverage, governed Python quality, exact diff scope, protected hashes, and independent review pass with no unexplained unverified item.

Run governed Python quality and Git diff/check/status hygiene selected by the exact changed-path risk surface.
rollback: Before approved application, delete only uncommitted GCR-0004 transaction artifacts; the frozen GCR-0003 state and untracked adverse ledger remain exact.

During an interrupted application, gcr4ctl recover must restore the exact frozen predecessor or complete the exact ledger-derived successor from the authenticated manifest; no manual partial cleanup is permitted.
After finalization, do not rewrite or roll back history; corrective work uses append-only GCR-0004 review remediation or ordinary GCR-0003 R02 review as applicable.
